<?php declare(strict_types=1);
namespace Kulturhus\Verein;
use PDO;
use DomainException;
use DOMDocument;
require_once dirname(dirname(__DIR__, 2),2).'/banking/PaymentRules.php';
use Kulturhus\Banking\PaymentRules;

/**
 * Reviewed outgoing SEPA transfers for supplier invoices.
 *
 * Creating and approving an order never books a payment. After a Kassenwart or
 * confirmed board-office approval, the order may either be exported for the
 * bank portal or submitted
 * through the reviewed FinTS dialog. In both cases the invoice stays open
 * until the actual bank transaction is imported and matched here.
 */
final class TransferOrders
{
 public function __construct(private PDO $db,private string $actor,private MemberBankVault $vault){}
 private function q(string $sql,array $args=[]):\PDOStatement{$q=$this->db->prepare($sql);$q->execute($args);return $q;}
 private function access():array{return Permissions::finance($this->db,$this->actor,true);}
 public function canManage():bool{try{$this->office($this->actor);return true;}catch(DomainException){return false;}}
 public function canSend():bool{return $this->canManage();}
 private function office(string $actor):array{return FinancePaymentAuthority::require($this->db,$actor);}
 private function tx(callable $work):mixed{$this->db->beginTransaction();try{$v=$work();$this->db->commit();return $v;}catch(\Throwable $e){$this->db->rollBack();throw $e;}}
 private function audit(string $action,string $id,int $version):void{$a=$this->access();$this->q('INSERT INTO audit_events(club_id,actor_id,action,object_id,object_version,happened_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)',[$a['club_id'],$a['id'],$action,$id,$version,gmdate('c')]);}
 public function ordersForEntry(string $entry):array{$a=$this->access();return $this->q('SELECT id,entry_id,account_id,execution_date,state,version,total_cents,created_at,bank_reference FROM finance_transfer_orders WHERE club_id=? AND entry_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC',[$a['club_id'],$entry])->fetchAll();}
 public function get(string $id):array{$a=$this->access();$r=$this->q('SELECT * FROM finance_transfer_orders WHERE club_id=? AND id=?',[$a['club_id'],$id])->fetch();if(!$r)throw new DomainException('Überweisungsauftrag nicht verfügbar.');$r['snapshot']=$this->vault->openTransfer($id,$r['sealed_snapshot']);return $r;}
 private static function purpose(string $value):string{$value=trim($value);if($value===''||mb_strlen($value)>140||preg_match('/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/',$value))throw new DomainException('Verwendungszweck mit höchstens 140 Zeichen eingeben.');return $value;}
 private function snapshot(string $entry,string $account,string $execution,string $purpose,string $mode='standard',bool $checkDate=true):array
 {
  $a=$this->access();$f=new Finance($this->db,$this->actor);$e=$f->entry($entry);if($e['kind']!=='expense')throw new DomainException('Nur eine Ausgabe kann bezahlt werden.');if(!in_array($e['payment_state'],['open','partial'],true)||$e['remaining_cents']<=0)throw new DomainException('Diese Rechnung ist bereits vollständig bezahlt oder abgeschlossen.');$paymentReport=(new InvoicePaymentReports($this->db,$this->actor))->summary($entry);if(($paymentReport['state']??'')==='reported')throw new DomainException('Diese Rechnung wurde bereits als bezahlt gemeldet. Erst die Zahlungsmeldung prüfen oder zurücknehmen; keine zweite Zahlung vorbereiten.');
  PaymentRules::transferMode($mode);BankImport::date($execution);if($checkDate&&($execution<date('Y-m-d')||($mode==='instant'&&$execution!==date('Y-m-d'))))throw new DomainException('Ausführungstag prüfen. Echtzeitüberweisungen bitte am Ausführungstag vorbereiten.');$purpose=self::purpose($purpose);
  $bank=$f->requireActiveAccount($account);if($bank['kind']!=='offline')throw new DomainException('Für eine Überweisung ein aktives Bankkonto auswählen.');$accountSettings=$f->accountSettings($account);if(!(int)($accountSettings['fints_write']??0))throw new DomainException('FinTS-Schreiben ist für dieses Vereinskonto noch gesperrt. In den Kontoeinstellungen zuerst „Erlaubt“ auswählen.');
  $clubBank=(new Settings($this->db,$this->actor))->section('bank')['data'];if(($clubBank['account_id']??'')!==$account)throw new DomainException('Dieses Vereinskonto zuerst als Bankverbindung des Vereins hinterlegen.');$sourceIban=Iban::normalize((string)($clubBank['iban']??''));if($sourceIban==='')throw new DomainException('Vereins-IBAN in den Vereinseinstellungen fehlt.');$sourceBic=strtoupper(preg_replace('/\s+/','',(string)($clubBank['bic']??'')));if($sourceBic!==''&&!preg_match('/^[A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}(?:[A-Z0-9]{3})?$/D',$sourceBic))throw new DomainException('Vereins-BIC prüfen.');
  $claim=$this->q("SELECT r.contact_id,r.state,c.name FROM finance_reimbursement_claims r JOIN contacts c ON c.club_id=r.club_id AND c.id=r.contact_id WHERE r.club_id=? AND r.entry_id=?",[$a['club_id'],$entry])->fetch();
  if($claim){
   if($claim['state']!=='approved')throw new DomainException('Die private Erstattung muss zuerst freigegeben werden.');
   $memberBank=$this->vault->bankForReimbursement((string)$claim['contact_id']);$bankData=$memberBank['bank'];$recipientName=trim((string)$claim['name']);$recipientIban=Iban::normalize((string)$bankData['iban']);$recipientBic=strtoupper(preg_replace('/\s+/','',(string)($bankData['bic']??'')));
   if($recipientName===''||mb_strlen($recipientName)>70)throw new DomainException('Mitgliedsname für die Erstattung prüfen.');
   if($recipientIban==='')throw new DomainException('IBAN des Mitglieds für die Erstattung prüfen.');
   if($recipientBic!==''&&!preg_match('/^[A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}(?:[A-Z0-9]{3})?$/D',$recipientBic))throw new DomainException('BIC des Mitglieds prüfen.');
  }else{
   $supplier=$this->q('SELECT s.contact_id,s.supplier_name,c.version FROM finance_supplier_contacts s JOIN contacts c ON c.club_id=s.club_id AND c.id=s.contact_id WHERE s.club_id=? AND s.entry_id=? AND c.kind=\'organisation\' AND c.archived_at IS NULL',[$a['club_id'],$entry])->fetch();if(!$supplier)throw new DomainException('Zuerst einen aktiven Firmenkontakt als Lieferant zuordnen.');$supplierBank=$this->q('SELECT iban,bic FROM supplier_bank_details WHERE club_id=? AND contact_id=?',[$a['club_id'],$supplier['contact_id']])->fetch();if(!$supplierBank||trim((string)$supplierBank['iban'])==='')throw new DomainException('Für den Lieferanten ist noch keine IBAN hinterlegt. Originalrechnung und Firmenkontakt prüfen.');$recipientIban=Iban::normalize((string)$supplierBank['iban']);$recipientBic=strtoupper(preg_replace('/\s+/','',(string)($supplierBank['bic']??'')));if($recipientBic!==''&&!preg_match('/^[A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}(?:[A-Z0-9]{3})?$/D',$recipientBic))throw new DomainException('Lieferanten-BIC prüfen.');
   $recipientName=trim((string)$supplier['supplier_name']);if($recipientName===''||mb_strlen($recipientName)>70)throw new DomainException('Lieferantenname für die Bankdatei prüfen.');
  }
  $sourceName=trim((string)($clubBank['holder']??''))?:(string)($bank['name']??'Verein');
  return ['entry_id'=>$entry,'entry_version'=>(int)$e['version'],'number'=>(string)$e['display_number'],'account_id'=>$account,'execution_date'=>$execution,'purpose'=>$purpose,'total_cents'=>(int)$e['remaining_cents'],'source'=>['name'=>$sourceName,'iban'=>$sourceIban,'bic'=>$sourceBic],'recipient'=>['name'=>$recipientName,'iban'=>$recipientIban,'bic'=>$recipientBic],'recipient_kind'=>$claim?'member-reimbursement':'supplier']+($mode==='instant'?['transfer_mode'=>'instant']:[]);
 }
 public function preview(string $entry,string $account,string $execution,string $purpose,string $mode='standard'):array{if($mode==='instant')$execution=date('Y-m-d');$s=$this->snapshot($entry,$account,$execution,$purpose,$mode);return ['hash'=>hash('sha256',json_encode($s,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)),'transfer_mode'=>$mode,'entry_id'=>$entry,'number'=>$s['number'],'execution_date'=>$s['execution_date'],'purpose'=>$s['purpose'],'total_cents'=>$s['total_cents'],'recipient_name'=>$s['recipient']['name'],'iban_masked'=>substr($s['recipient']['iban'],0,2).' •••• '.substr($s['recipient']['iban'],-4)];}
 public function prepare(string $entry,string $account,string $execution,string $purpose,string $expected,string $key,string $mode='standard'):string
 {
  if(!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/D',$key)||!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D',$expected))throw new DomainException('Zahlungsformular neu öffnen.');return $this->tx(function()use($entry,$account,$execution,$purpose,$expected,$key,$mode){$a=$this->access();$old=$this->q('SELECT id,snapshot_hash FROM finance_transfer_orders WHERE club_id=? AND request_key=?',[$a['club_id'],$key])->fetch();if($old){if(!hash_equals($old['snapshot_hash'],$expected))throw new DomainException('Zahlungsformular bereits anders verwendet.');return $old['id'];}$s=$this->snapshot($entry,$account,$execution,$purpose,$mode);$hash=hash('sha256',json_encode($s,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));if(!hash_equals($hash,$expected))throw new DomainException('Rechnung, Bankdaten oder Betrag verändert. Vorschau erneut prüfen.');if($this->q("SELECT 1 FROM finance_transfer_orders WHERE club_id=? AND entry_id=? AND state IN ('prepared','approved','exported','submitted')",[$a['club_id'],$entry])->fetchColumn())throw new DomainException('Für diese Rechnung besteht bereits ein laufender Überweisungsauftrag.');$id=bin2hex(random_bytes(16));$created=gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z');$s['id']=$id;$s['created_at']=$created;$s['xml']=self::xml($s);$this->q("INSERT INTO finance_transfer_orders(club_id,id,entry_id,account_id,execution_date,state,created_by,created_at,request_key,snapshot_hash,sealed_snapshot,total_cents) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,'prepared',?,?,?,?,?,?)",[$a['club_id'],$id,$entry,$account,$execution,$a['id'],$created,$key,$hash,$this->vault->sealTransfer($id,$s),$s['total_cents']]);$this->audit('finance.transfer.prepared',$id,1);return $id;});
 }
 private function current(array $order,bool $checkDate=true):array{$s=$order['snapshot']??$this->vault->openTransfer($order['id'],$order['sealed_snapshot']);$now=$this->snapshot($s['entry_id'],$s['account_id'],$s['execution_date'],$s['purpose'],$s['transfer_mode']??'standard',$checkDate);if(!hash_equals((string)$order['snapshot_hash'],hash('sha256',json_encode($now,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR))))throw new DomainException('Rechnung, Bankdaten oder Betrag wurden geändert. Überweisungsauftrag neu vorbereiten.');return $s;}
 /** Return the immutable, revalidated payload for a direct FinTS submission. */
 public function fintsPayload(string $id,int $version):array{$this->office($this->actor);$r=$this->get($id);if($r['state']!=='approved'||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Nur ein aktuell freigegebener Auftrag kann über FinTS gesendet werden.');(new InvoiceApprovals($this->db,$this->actor))->assertApproved($r['entry_id']);$s=$this->current($r);$o=$this->office((string)$r['approved_by']);if((int)$o['version']!==(int)$r['office_version'])throw new DomainException('Freigabeamt geändert. Auftrag neu prüfen.');return ['order_id'=>$r['id'],'order_version'=>(int)$r['version'],'account_id'=>$r['account_id'],'source_iban'=>$s['source']['iban'],'xml'=>$s['xml'],'reference'=>'FinTS KH'.$r['id'],'transfer_mode'=>$s['transfer_mode']??'standard'];}
 /** Mark only a bank-confirmed FinTS result as submitted; never books the invoice. */
 public function markFintsSubmitted(string $id,int $version,string $reference):void{$reference=trim($reference);if($reference===''||mb_strlen($reference)>200)throw new DomainException('Bankbestätigung prüfen.');$this->tx(function()use($id,$version,$reference){$a=$this->access();$this->office($this->actor);$r=$this->get($id);if($r['state']!=='approved'||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Überweisungsauftrag wurde bereits verarbeitet oder geändert.');$this->current($r,false);$this->office((string)$r['approved_by']);$this->q("UPDATE finance_transfer_orders SET state='submitted',bank_reference=?,version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$reference,$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('finance.transfer.fints_submitted',$id,$version+1);});}
 public function approve(string $id,int $version):void{$this->tx(function()use($id,$version){$a=$this->access();$r=$this->get($id);if($r['state']!=='prepared'||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Unveränderten vorbereiteten Überweisungsauftrag auswählen.');$this->current($r);$o=$this->office($this->actor);(new InvoiceApprovals($this->db,$this->actor))->assertApproved($r['entry_id']);$this->q("UPDATE finance_transfer_orders SET state='approved',approved_by=?,approved_at=?,office_version=?,version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$a['id'],gmdate('c'),$o['version'],$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('finance.transfer.approved',$id,$version+1);});}
 public function export(string $id,int $version):string{return $this->tx(function()use($id,$version){$a=$this->access();$this->office($this->actor);$r=$this->get($id);if(!in_array($r['state'],['approved','exported'],true)||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Zuerst den aktuellen Zahlungsauftrag freigeben.');(new InvoiceApprovals($this->db,$this->actor))->assertApproved($r['entry_id']);$s=$this->current($r);$o=$this->office((string)$r['approved_by']);if((int)$o['version']!==(int)$r['office_version'])throw new DomainException('Freigabeamt geändert. Auftrag neu prüfen.');if($r['state']==='approved'){$this->q("UPDATE finance_transfer_orders SET state='exported',exported_at=?,version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[gmdate('c'),$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('finance.transfer.exported',$id,$version+1);}return $s['xml'];});}
 public function submitted(string $id,int $version,string $reference):void{$reference=trim($reference);if($reference===''||mb_strlen($reference)>200)throw new DomainException('Bankbestätigung oder Auftragsnummer eingeben.');$this->tx(function()use($id,$version,$reference){$a=$this->access();$this->office($this->actor);$r=$this->get($id);if($r['state']!=='exported'||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Unveränderten exportierten Auftrag auswählen.');$this->q("UPDATE finance_transfer_orders SET state='submitted',bank_reference=?,version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$reference,$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('finance.transfer.externally_submitted',$id,$version+1);});}
 public function cancel(string $id,int $version):void{$this->tx(function()use($id,$version){$a=$this->access();$r=$this->get($id);if(!in_array($r['state'],['prepared','approved'],true)||(int)$r['version']!==$version)throw new DomainException('Exportierte Überweisungen zuerst bei der Bank klären.');$this->q("UPDATE finance_transfer_orders SET state='cancelled',version=version+1 WHERE club_id=? AND id=?",[$a['club_id'],$id]);$this->audit('finance.transfer.cancelled',$id,$version+1);});}
 public static function xml(array $s):string
 {
  $mode=PaymentRules::transferMode($s['transfer_mode']??'standard');$d=new DOMDocument('1.0','UTF-8');$d->formatOutput=true;$ns='urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.001.001.09';$root=$d->createElementNS($ns,'Document');$d->appendChild($root);$add=static function($parent,string $name,?string $value=null)use($d,$ns){$n=$d->createElementNS($ns,$name);if($value!==null)$n->appendChild($d->createTextNode($value));$parent->appendChild($n);return $n;};$init=$add($root,'CstmrCdtTrfInitn');$h=$add($init,'GrpHdr');$add($h,'MsgId','KH'.$s['id']);$add($h,'CreDtTm',$s['created_at']);$add($h,'NbOfTxs','1');$add($h,'CtrlSum',Finance::decimal($s['total_cents']));$add($add($h,'InitgPty'),'Nm',mb_substr($s['source']['name'],0,70));$p=$add($init,'PmtInf');$add($p,'PmtInfId','KH'.$s['id']);$add($p,'PmtMtd','TRF');$add($p,'BtchBookg','false');$add($p,'NbOfTxs','1');$add($p,'CtrlSum',Finance::decimal($s['total_cents']));$type=$add($p,'PmtTpInf');$lvl=$add($type,'SvcLvl');$add($lvl,'Cd','SEPA');if($mode==='instant')$add($add($type,'LclInstrm'),'Cd','INST');$req=$add($p,'ReqdExctnDt');$add($req,'Dt',$s['execution_date']);$add($add($p,'Dbtr'),'Nm',mb_substr($s['source']['name'],0,70));$sourceAcct=$add($add($p,'DbtrAcct'),'Id');$add($sourceAcct,'IBAN',$s['source']['iban']);$agent=$add($add($p,'DbtrAgt'),'FinInstnId');if($s['source']['bic']!=='')$add($agent,'BICFI',$s['source']['bic']);else $add($add($agent,'Othr'),'Id','NOTPROVIDED');$add($p,'ChrgBr','SLEV');$tx=$add($p,'CdtTrfTxInf');$add($add($tx,'PmtId'),'EndToEndId','KH'.substr($s['id'],0,24).'-1');$amt=$add($add($tx,'Amt'),'InstdAmt',Finance::decimal($s['total_cents']));$amt->setAttribute('Ccy','EUR');if($s['recipient']['bic']!=='')$add($add($add($tx,'CdtrAgt'),'FinInstnId'),'BICFI',$s['recipient']['bic']);$add($add($tx,'Cdtr'),'Nm',mb_substr($s['recipient']['name'],0,70));$add($add($add($tx,'CdtrAcct'),'Id'),'IBAN',$s['recipient']['iban']);$add($add($tx,'RmtInf'),'Ustrd',mb_substr($s['purpose'],0,140));$xml=$d->saveXML();if($xml===false||!$d->documentElement||$d->documentElement->localName!=='Document')throw new DomainException('Überweisungsdatei konnte nicht erstellt werden.');$old=libxml_use_internal_errors(true);try{if(!$d->schemaValidate(dirname(dirname(__DIR__, 2),2).'/banking/schemas/pain.001.001.09_GBIC_5.xsd'))throw new DomainException('Überweisungsdatei entspricht nicht dem SEPA-Format. Angaben prüfen.');}finally{libxml_clear_errors();libxml_use_internal_errors($old);}return $xml;
 }
}
